About the author

Gurpreet Singh

Gurpreet Singh founded House of Aspirants and writes its monthly current affairs magazine, its weekly live session summaries and the preparation strategy pages. He reviews the exam-oriented material published on this portal against the official syllabus and the official notifications, and mentors aspirants preparing for Punjab Police, PSSSB and PPSC examinations.
